europe_now.title: Nationwide Protests in France
europe_now.summary: Trade union-backed strikes and demonstrations over living costs have drawn significant crowds across France, with tens of thousands participating. The interior ministry and union organizers reported varying turnout figures as public services and schools face severe pressure.

sources.headline: French protests see numbers surge as unions join strikes over high cost of living

top_stories.title: French Cyberattack and Financial Loss
top_stories.summary: A major online cyberattack targeting a French bank resulted in hackers stealing approximately 100 million dollars. The incident highlights ongoing digital security vulnerabilities within the French financial sector.

sources.headline: Cyberattack: French bank says online hacking stole around $100 million
French bank hit by cyberattack, hackers steal $100 million

top_stories.title: Judicial Reforms and European Mediation
top_stories.summary: The Polish government has indicated a willingness to engage in EU mediation regarding its ongoing domestic court crisis. Officials suggest that the most emotionally charged aspects of the dispute are drawing closer to a resolution.
